tex_content.label: harnackinequality
tex_content.html: \begin{equation} R(x_2,t_2)\geq \exp \left(-\frac{d_{t_1}^2(x_1,x_2)}{2(t_2-t_1)}\right)R(x_1,t_1). \end{equation} For $n=2$, the denominator in the exponential may be replaced by $4(t_2-t_1)$; if $R(x_2,t_2)=0$, then $g(t)$ is flat for all $t$.
